item.title: About
item.description:
I’m Guilong Liu. This site collects my learning notes on robotics, simulation, development environments, and technical writing.

Topics

  • Unitree G1, ROS 2, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, and navigation.
  • Ubuntu and Docker development environments.
  • Hugo, Markdown, and mathematical typesetting.
  • VS Code, XeLaTeX, and Biber.

Most technical articles are written in Chinese. Use the reading guide to choose a topic, or switch to Chinese to browse the full article archive.

Contact

Email: guilonglgl@gmail.com

item.title: Reading guide
item.description:
Most articles are in Chinese. The Chinese reading guide links to every tutorial in the following groups:

  • Robotics: Unitree repositories and SDK, ROS 2 communication, G1 interfaces, MuJoCo, and navigation.
  • Isaac: basic Isaac Lab scenes and the separate Isaac Sim / Humble navigation workflow.
  • Development: Ubuntu installation and Docker for robotics.
  • Website: Hugo with Stack, Markdown, and MathJax.
  • Writing: VS Code with XeLaTeX and Biber.

The standalone World Models guide is available as an interactive HTML page.

Choose either the MuJoCo / Jazzy or Isaac Sim / Humble workflow after the ROS fundamentals. Follow each project’s environment requirements separately.
